frequency_question: How often does Congress successfully pass a joint resolution of disapproval to block a major nuclear cooperation agreement within the statutory review window?
membership_rule: Includes formal 123 agreements submitted to Congress requiring a 60-day or 90-day continuous session review period where a joint resolution of disapproval was introduced and brought to a vote. Excludes informal consultations or agreements not formally submitted under Section 123.

cases.name: Iran Nuclear Agreement Review Act (INARA) votes

provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 major contested cases identified in the modern statutory era; none resulted in a successful blocking resolution due to presidential veto capacity or lack of veto-proof majorities.
known_gaps: Minor technical renewals of 123 agreements that passed without formal congressional friction are excluded as non-controversial baselines.
skeleton: Formal 123 agreement transmittals resulting in floor votes on joint resolutions of disapproval
multiplier: 3 transmittals with high controversy resulting in 0 successful override-proof blocks
validity_reason: The statutory framework under the Atomic Energy Act of 1954 and NNPA of 1978 remains unchanged, but polarization dynamics could shift the baseline slowly.
